issues.description: Training activities under the fellowship integrate transferable skills including digital skills (e.g. generative AI), foster Open Science culture and knowledge valorisation, and uphold good scientific conduct including research integrity; a Career Development Plan (D1.3) is jointly established by the supervisor(s) and the researcher and submitted at the beginning of the action.
issues.source_basis: Confirmed in Tier 2B scope_requirements.json SR-04 and SR-05 and call_constraints.json CC-09 and CC-10 (docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/scope_requirements.json; docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/call_constraints.json). The Tier 3 compliance_profile.json open_science_requirements records the same obligation as a confirming secondary reference; Tier 1 implementation_constraints.json ethics_appraisal_summary grounds the integrity dimension.

ethics_assessment.self_assessment_statement: A full ethics self-assessment will be completed as an essential and integral part of the proposal, in line with the Tier 1 requirement (implementation_constraints.json ethics_self_assessment_required) that applicants complete an ethics self-assessment and that projects with ethics issues may undergo ethics review with ethics requirements becoming contractual obligations. The Tier 3 compliance_profile.json records ethics_review_required: true as a compliance flag derived during call binding; no Tier 2B extracted source path currently cites an ethics review as a topic-specific mandate for this call, so this is treated as a Tier 3 derivative flag pending call-specific confirmation. Identified areas for self-assessment are: personal data / data protection arising from agronomic and farmer-field datasets; artificial-intelligence considerations from the predictive and decision-support models; and research integrity and good scientific conduct, the last of which is confirmed as a call obligation in Tier 2B (SR-04, CC-09, SR-05, CC-10). The action focuses exclusively on civil applications (Tier 1 civil_focus_constraint). On gender: integration of the gender dimension in research and innovation content follows the Tier 1 default rule (implementation_constraints.json gender_dimension_in_content) that it is mandatory unless the topic explicitly states non-relevance. No Tier 2B exemption source is currently cited in this Phase 6 artifact; Phase 8 drafting must either add the relevant Tier 2B topic-source reference or keep the claim framed as pending call-specific confirmation. On gender balance and equality: the Tier 3 compliance_profile.json records gender_plan_required: true, consistent with the Tier 1 gender_equality_plan_eligibility requirement that public bodies, research organisations and higher education establishments hold a gender equality plan, and the Tier 1 gender_management_balance_guidance to aim for gender balance at all levels of personnel including supervisory and managerial level.
